close.close_rationale: Closed at the authoring instant, deliberately BEFORE the 2026-08-28 readings exist, so that the forecast window shuts while the outcome is still unknowable. This is the anti-hindsight posture and it is also the ledger's structural requirement: ProposeResolution is legal only from state CLOSED or DISPUTED, so MIDAS-06's flow necessarily includes a CloseQuestion before its resolution. closed_at equals submitted_at exactly; the validator forbids closed_at following submitted_at. Closing here does not shorten the CLAIM window, which the question's closes_at fixes at the end of the 2026-08-28 observation date; it shuts only the forecasting window, and this question has a single registered forecaster.

forecast.decision_consequence: Signal-only. This forecast authorizes no trade, moves no matrix score, and changes no band or threshold; MIDAS-06's own if-falsified action is a channel-score move and a Will-gated spec question, never a position. *** THE PROBABILITY IS NOT A STANDARD BINARY AND MUST NOT BE SCORED AS ONE. 0.45 is the probability of branch (a) EXACTLY AS RECORDED IN THE FROZEN LETTER ON 2026-08-07, before any outcome was observable: the letter's own registered distribution is P(a) ~0.45, P(b) ~0.20, P(c) ~0.15, P(d) ~0.20. Under this question's four-to-three mapping that is P(YES)=0.45, P(NO)=0.20, P(AMBIGUOUS)=0.35. THEREFORE P(NO) IS 0.20 AND NOT 1-0.45=0.55, and any Brier or log score computed against a two-outcome assumption will be wrong. *** information_as_of is deliberately set to the 2026-08-07 registration date rather than the authoring date. The number was NOT computed tonight: it is transcribed from the frozen letter, which recorded it before the outcome was knowable. Authoring on 2026-08-27, gold had already cleared the branch-(a) gold leg by 5.93 percent and DFII10 stood 6 basis points below the binding leg, so a probability formed tonight would have been a nowcast on nearly complete information wearing the costume of a forecast. Entering the recorded ex-ante figure is the only construction under which this row's calibration record means anything.

question.ambiguity_rule: AMBIGUOUS is a registered legitimate outcome of this question, not a failure to resolve it. Will's row-68 ruling states in terms that (d) INDETERMINATE is a legitimate outcome of a frozen spec and not a defect to patch mid-flight. DO NOT collapse branch (d) into NO: NO is reserved for branch (b), which is a directional falsifier asserting gold broke DOWN through 4050.00 while yields held at or above 2.40, and reading an indeterminate grade as NO would assert a falsification the letter does not support. DO NOT resolve YES on the gold leg alone; the binding leg is DFII10 versus 2.40 and it is the leg that fails on current readings. DO NOT substitute a nearby DFII10 print for the 2026-08-28 observation to escape an indeterminate grade. If the gold settlement is at or above 4340.70 on one basis and below it on the other, that disagreement is itself branch (d) and resolves AMBIGUOUS. Ties resolve INTO the branch: 'at or above' includes exact equality at 4340.70 and at 2.40, and the letter's own record notes the 2026-08-21 observation of exactly 2.40 satisfied the leg.
annulment_rules: Annul only if FRED and the Federal Reserve H.15 release permanently cease to publish the 10-year Treasury inflation-indexed constant-maturity series and no successor series preserves the 2026-08-28 observation, such that the yield leg can never be read on any basis.

Annul only if COMEX gold settlement records for trade date 2026-08-28 become permanently unavailable from both the exchange and the registered fallback, such that the gold leg cannot be read on any basis.
question.claim: MIDAS-06 resolves branch (a) of its frozen letter: on the readings the letter names for 2026-08-28, the COMEX gold front-month settlement is at or above 4340.70 US dollars per troy ounce AND the FRED DFII10 observation dated 2026-08-28 is at or above 2.40 percent, so the gold / real-yield divergence (the debasement premium) is a durable reassertion rather than a mean-reverting melt-up.
question.fallback_resolution_source: For the yield leg, the Federal Reserve H.15 release archive for the statement week containing 2026-08-28, which is the primary publication FRED redistributes. For the gold leg, the CME Group daily settlement record for the named contract month, cross-checked against the GLD closing price as a direction-only corroborant that is NOT unit-matched to the futures basis and never substitutes for a settlement.
question.resolution_condition: Resolves YES if and only if BOTH legs of the letter's branch (a) hold: the COMEX gold front-month settlement for trade date 2026-08-28 is >= 4340.70 USD/oz AND the FRED DFII10 observation DATED 2026-08-28 is >= 2.40 percent. Resolves NO if and only if the letter's branch (b) holds: that gold settlement is < 4050.00 USD/oz while the same DFII10 observation is >= 2.40 percent. Resolves AMBIGUOUS if the letter's branch (c) holds (that DFII10 observation is < 2.20 percent, which the letter VOIDS as a divergence test and calls NO-CALL) or its branch (d) holds (any combination the first three branches do not cover, which the letter calls INDETERMINATE).
question.resolution_rule: The underlying row MIDAS-06 is a FROZEN LETTER under Will's ruling of 2026-08-21 (WILL_QUEUE row 68; record PROME/proposals/2026-08-21_midas-rows-65-69-RULED.md): NO EDIT, and it grades on the letter as written. This question is a faithful binary projection of that four-branch letter and changes none of its terms; where the letter and this projection ever appear to differ, THE LETTER GOVERNS. Four-to-three mapping, stated explicitly because the ledger's forecast_family is BINARY_PROBABILITY and the letter is not binary: (a) -> YES, (b) -> NO, (c) -> AMBIGUOUS, (d) -> AMBIGUOUS. GOLD LEG BASIS: yfinance's GC=F front-month pointer rolled from GCQ26 to GCZ26 between registration and resolution; per L-19 and the row-68 observation filed 2026-08-23, BOTH bases (continuous GC=F and the named current front contract) are printed at resolution, and the roll is not outcome-determinative because gold clears 4340.70 by more than 4 percent on either basis. Never quote a delta across the GCQ26/GCZ26 pair as like-for-like. DFII10 LEG TIMING: per Will's class ruling of 2026-08-27 (option (i); record PROME/proposals/2026-08-27_lagged-series-grade-date-RULED.md), for a lagged-publication series the named OBSERVATION DATE governs and the grade WAITS for publication. The 2026-08-28 observation publishes Monday 2026-08-31 at approximately 16:15 ET in the Federal Reserve H.15 release. NO SUBSTITUTE PRINT INSTANTIATES THIS CELL: not the 2026-08-27 observation, not the last observation available on 2026-08-28, not any later revision. The gold leg may be read at the 2026-08-28 settlement and the resolution held provisional until the DFII10 observation publishes. A resolution proposed before that publication is premature and must not be submitted.
